component.name: ChannelsFetcher
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() xfer = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") xfer.SetUrl(m.top.apiBase + "/api/channels") xfer.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") xfer.InitClientCertificates() xfer.SetRequest("GET") resp = xfer.GetToString() if resp = invalid or resp = "" m.top.error = "Could not reach network" return end if data = ParseJson(resp) if data = invalid m.top.error = "Invalid channel data" return end if m.top.channels = { list: data } end sub
